verdict.rationale: Highnote's own spend rules are documented to permit or restrict transactions on authorizations based on merchant category codes (MCC), which covers allow and block logic. Its marketing also states that merchant category restrictions are evaluated at authorization, before funds move, and can be set at card, account, or program level. However, nothing in the evidence documents single-merchant locks; collaborative authorization is only a building block that could construct one. Missing for 10: documented single-merchant/merchant-ID lock capability, explicit allowlist vs blocklist configuration detail, independent or hands-on corroboration.
